description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FoodDetailsSlider that displays a carousel of images for food item details. It uses the carousel_pro package to implement the image slider with customization options such as dot indicators and radius.

classes.name: FoodDetailsSlider
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a carousel of images with customizable indicators and rounded borders.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the FoodDetailsSlider, which includes a Padding and a Container with a Carousel of images.
